notes.title: Corrective Update 2024.04.19
notes.content:
Optimization:
[olist]
[*] Added quantity prompts when selecting pieces in the Wild Brawl selection interface.
[*] Added available prompts for supplies and buildings in the game.
[*] Added prompts for damage numbers, highlighting the attack effects of high damage and high attack speed pieces.
[/olist]

Adjustments:
[olist]
[*] Changed the stacking method of fatigue damage from addition to multiplication.
[/olist]

Note:
Regarding the Mac version of the game, it is currently normal to play and risk-free. Please ignore the following prompts if they appear:
[olist]
[*] Your macOS version cannot run 32-bit games. This game may not run.
[/olist]

notes.title: Corrective Update 2024.03.22
notes.content:
Fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the combo achievement statistics were missing 1 count.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Blood Knight's trample ability would attack its own teammates.
[*] Fixed bugs in the current scouting mechanism.
[/olist]

Optimizations:
[olist]
[*] Optimized the automatic adaptation of the initial map size to accommodate the initial number of pieces, solving the problem of insufficient initial cells.
[*] Optimized the movement distance of level 2 unit pieces and resource pieces to 2 cells.
[/olist]

Additions:
[olist]
[*] Added a one-click reshuffle function in Incarnation mode, which can be used during the victory stage of battles.
[*] Added a frame rate limiting feature in the system settings.
[/olist]

notes.title: Corrective Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue in Mode Wild Brawl where market regulation and logistics squads ignored iron ore resources.
[*] Fixed the issue where accumulated level buffs were not cleared when abandoning progress in Mode Wild Brawl from the main interface.
[/olist]

Optimizations:
[olist]
[*] Completing any faction's Mode Casual unlocks Mode Wild Brawl and Mode Heroic Incarnation. 
[*] Strengthened the Guardian Idol and Fearless Idol.
[*] Enhanced the effects of all priority recruitment builds.
[*] Weakened Divine Judgment and Punishment of Sin.
[*] Adjusted the victory options in Mode Heroic Incarnation to 5.
[*] Added a prompt of "Unable to complete achievements" on the Heroic Incarnation selection panel.
[*] Greatly strengthened the attribute enhancement effects of exclusive unit builds.
[/olist]

Additions:
[olist]
[*] Added a "Directly enter combat phase" option to the settings menu in Mode Heroic Incarnation.
[*] Added "Disarmament Plan", "Precision Movement", and "Precision Synthesis" to the level buff pool.
[/olist]

notes.title: Thank you for your patience. The game is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
Today, we finally welcome the release of the game.

This journey has been filled with hardships and challenges, but at this moment, everything becomes incredibly worthwhile.

Thank you to all the players who have supported us, and we look forward to meeting you in the game!

notes.title: Free Demo Now Available
notes.content:
Dear players of "Dungeon No Dungeon,"

We are thrilled to announce the official release of the free demo version of "Tyrant's Endgame"! After a year of creativity and hard work, we can finally share this moment with all of you. Behind this moment lies the resilience and dedication of three ordinary individuals over the past year, a testament to our unwavering pursuit of our dreams, and a genuine outpouring of emotions.

"Tyrant's Endgame" pays tribute to the original version of the series, "Dungeon No Dungeon," while embarking on a new adventure filled with innovation and challenges. It is not just a game but a legacy of emotions, a proof of our passion for gaming. Every attempt and failure has made us cherish this dedication even more. We have redesigned the gameplay and mechanics to offer you an unprecedented gaming experience. While our new modes will be introduced in the full release, even the demo version offers a glimpse of the game's brilliance.

Compared to the previous game, "Tyrant's Endgame" places a stronger emphasis on gameplay and challenge. We present deeper strategies, more diverse decisions, and a world of possibilities in the game. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned player, you can find your own challenges within the game.

"Dungeon No Dungeon" is our very own IP, and we hope to introduce more people to and inspire a love for this world full of fantasy and adventure through friendly and entertaining gameplay. We believe "Tyrant's Endgame" will bring you joy and surprises, just as we experienced when creating it.

We are a small but ambitious team, eager to go further, persist, live on, and create more enjoyable games. To our loyal players, you've been with us since the beginning, supporting and guiding us. We appreciate your recognition, which has brought us to where we are today and helped us create our second game. To the new players, we welcome you to join us on this authentic journey and are willing to share it with you. Your support will inspire us to work harder and strive for excellence. We deeply appreciate everyone who supports us because it is you who enables us to keep moving forward, innovating, and creating more meaningful games.

Thank you for your support, and let's embark on the adventure of "Dungeon No Dungeon: Tyrant's Endgame" together. Please download our demo version now and join our community to share your gaming experiences and suggestions with us. We look forward to exploring this fascinating world with you!

Wishing you enjoyable moments in the game!

Best regards,
302 Studio

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign is approaching! Starting on Saturday, October 21th at 10 AM
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I am the game developer, Larcen!

After a long wait, we're reuniting once again, and our new game "Tyrant's Endgame" is finally about to meet everyone!

We have initiated a special pre-launch event on Kickstarter. This is not only an opportunity to fund the project but also a chance to create the game together with all of you. It's a crucial moment where we can participate together and influence the game's development process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200928/ff045edcdab00481f340087f90b6e29b45d16a15.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/302games/dungeon-no-dungeon-tyrants-endgame]Click the link to join our event and get exclusive early-bird discounts![/url]

Thank you for your continuous support. We can't wait to embark on this adventure with you. Let's together write a new chapter in the history of gaming!

Once again, thank you all. Because of you, everything becomes possible.

Larcen, Respectfully Yours
